cms.admin_help: Logo, colour, header and start page banner of the website template. Create menus for the header, footer columns and quick links under Menus (positions “top-bar”, “header-nav”, “footer-1” … “footer-4”, “footer”).
cms.logo_help: Raster image (PNG, JPEG, WebP), ideally with a transparent background.
cms.logo_light_help: Optional: light variant shown over the start page image.
cms.logo_height_help: Default 56; the logo gets smaller when scrolling.
cms.primary_color_help: For links, active menu items and buttons. Please choose a dark colour (contrast to white at least 4.5 : 1).
cms.header_overlay: Transparent over the start image, white when scrolling
cms.hero_image_help: Large image at the top of the start page, e.g. 2400 × 1200 pixels.
cms.banner_help: Shows the page title large over an image (as on university websites).
cms.banner_image_help: Without its own image the start image is used.
cms.copyright_help: e.g. “© {year} Example University” – {year} is replaced by the current year.
